answer_1.quote: In this paper, we present a set of analyses aimed at mechanistically interpreting LMs on the task of answering simple arithmetic questions (e.g., "What is the product of 11 and 17?").

answer_2.quote: We report the accuracy results in Appendix B.

answer_3.quote: We quantify the contribution of model components by intervening on their activations and measuring changes in output probabilities.
